notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping the seven lands.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping the seven lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Cavern Harpy and Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
